svg.title: B-cell precursor
svg.desc: Round B-cell precursor with a large nucleus, thin green cytoplasm, and early B-lineage receptors. Biological basis: B-cell precursors are small lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin and limited cytoplasm before maturation into receptor-rich B cells.
